summary: Iteration 2 verifies the new AI Citation Tracker, sidebar rename to 'AI Auto-Blogger', dynamic robots.txt (41 user-agents incl. GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/Google-Extended/Applebot/MicrosoftPreview/MistralAI-User and dynamic Sitemap directive), .htaccess rewrites for sitemap.xml + merchant-feed.xml + robots.txt, blog-post internal linking (related posts + related products), and weekly citation cron registration. All checks pass end-to-end on the public preview URL and on localhost.

tests_executed.citation_weekly_php_lint: No syntax errors detected in cron/citation-weekly.php

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: review request mentioned a single data-testid 'related-product-side-showcase' but the implementation uses per-slug ids (data-testid=related-product-{slug}). The per-slug variant is actually MORE useful for selector-stable testing, so this is an improvement, not a bug. Consider documenting the convention.

Dynamic robots.txt depends on $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST']; behind a reverse proxy that rewrites Host (e.g., Cloudflare with 'Host header override'), this is correct. When deployed to bare Apache via the included .htaccess, the rewrite will route to robots-dynamic.php as expected.
AI Citation Tracker stores brand mention rate and accuracy across 5 engines — consider adding a weekly trend sparkline so admins can see drift over time.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-populated citation responses and the 7 AI posts (ids 51-57). Did NOT trigger Run citation check per instructions (would burn LLM budget).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Citation tracker has 10 stored responses across 5 engines. To re-test the LLM call path itself, hit the [data-testid=seo-citation-run-now] button — be aware it spends LLM budget (25 calls per full run: 5 engines × 5 questions). Dynamic robots.txt should be tested via http://localhost:3000/robots.txt curl from inside the pod because the K8s ingress may cache the legacy static path. Production hosting will use .htaccess rewrites which are now in place.
